# Ginés Sánchez

> People often see what could work better. Acting on it is harder.

Ginés works with owners and teams to understand what gets in the way, test
practical changes, and help the people creating value share in it.
Anthropology, technology, and experiments in how we work together.

## Working together

Start with something that isn’t working. An initial conversation explores the
problem and whether there is a useful experiment to run together.

The main introduction is visible on arrival. Work together, The work, Play,
Culture Decides, and About open within the same page, one section at a time.

## The work

Projects being developed through Alteridad. Fit and what remains to be tested
are assessed with each team; this is not a claim of a completed product suite.

- [Chieftain](https://chieftain.ing/): culture. Investigating where useful
  observations get lost, what can be said, and who can make a change.
- [MicroManager](https://micromanager.app/): incentives and responsibility.
  Exploring how contributions, responsibility, and rewards can connect.
- [Replena](https://replena.ai/): demand, inventory, and purchasing. Testing
  algorithms and AI for buying decisions, costs, and their consequences.
- [Culture Decides](https://ginesanchez.com/#book): a book in
  progress about how culture shapes what we notice and do, and how to see,
  question, and change it in practice.
- [Alteridad](https://www.alteridad.org/): the company behind the work.

## About

Ginés trained as an anthropologist, working with Ngäbe communities in Panama
on language, knowledge, and different ways of living. Alongside research he
made art and films; today he builds software, writes, and keeps drawing.
His ambition is to make more room for people’s creative potential and for a
society that is beautiful to live in.

## A small world

The homepage bestiary contains freely roaming organisms from Ginés's sketchbook.
They keep individual shapes, paces, and paths. An optional control enables local
anticipation so neighbours give one another space to unfold, without a shared
destination or uniform motion. This is a drawing experiment in sharing space.
It pauses when its section closes and supports manual steps for reduced motion.

- [Play](https://ginesanchez.com/#bestiary): open the optional drawing experiment.
- [The work](https://ginesanchez.com/#work)
- [About](https://ginesanchez.com/#about)
